summary: Iteration 32 — FCM Web Push scaffold in unconfigured (fail-safe) state. Verified backend endpoints, presence-aware no-op behavior, MongoDB unique-index upsert semantics, and regressions on chat/like/receipt. Verified frontend Settings 'PUSH-УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ' section renders pending-admin message and correctly hides enable/off/test buttons when Firebase env vars are empty. Existing reply-feature test IDs remain intact.
critical_code_review_comments: push.py is clean, fail-safe, and small (~250 LOC). init_fcm caches _fcm_ready; is_configured() checks both PROJECT_ID + (inline JSON or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS). Good.
should_push() correctly falls back to DB last_active > 60s when ws_manager is absent — safe default.
send_to_user prunes UnregisteredError/InvalidArgumentError tokens — good hygiene once real FCM is wired.

Pre-existing (unrelated to iter-32): backend.err.log shows a legacy TypeError in /api/... GridFS stream close path (server.py:1305 'await gout.close()' where gout is None). Not triggered by push flows, but worth cleaning up in a future iteration.
DELETE /api/push/token accepts token in JSON body — non-standard for DELETE; consider a query param or path segment for stricter REST clients, but current impl works and is tested.
test_credentials: admin@lovreski.ru / LovreskiAdmin2026!, testuser1@lovreski.ru / password123, testuser2@lovreski.ru / password123 (auto-registered by tests)
seed_data_creation: Auto-registers testuser2@lovreski.ru if missing; also creates a like/match between testuser1 and testuser2 and one chat message. Push token doc for testuser1 is created then deleted (clean).
context_for_next_testing_agent: When Firebase creds are pasted into backend/.env (FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID + FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON) and frontend/.env (REACT_APP_FIREBASE_*), re-run tests: /api/push/status should return configured:true with a vapid_public_key; /api/push/test should return sent:1 for a real device token. Also verify the Settings UI shows the btn-push-on button (unconfigured→configured transition) and that after enabling, btn-push-off + btn-push-test appear. The Reply testids (reply-preview, action-sheet, quoted-<id>) live in /app/frontend/src/pages/ChatRoomPage.jsx and are unchanged.
